records.title: Greenfield Airport Policy, 2008
details:
c: In the state of Maharashtra, AAI has taken up works for reconstruction of old Terminal Building at Pune airport and resurfacing of Runways at Juhu Airport. Further, Maharashtra Airport Development Company Ltd. (MADC) has undertaken construction of New Integrated Terminal Building and associated infrastructure
at Shirdi International Airport and also development of Ratnagiri airport under RCS-UDAN.
